top_story.headline: Lobbyist reports billing $20,000 for work on a pardon application
top_story.dek: A third-quarter lobbying report shows Mintz Levin was paid $20,000 on behalf of Abdeslam Jaidi for communications with the Pardon Office.
paragraphs: Mintz Levin Cohn Ferris Glovsky and Popeo, P.C. reported $20,000 in income from client Abdeslam Jaidi in a third-quarter Lobbying Disclosure Act report. The issue description says that in July the firm communicated with the Pardon Office to submit information from the application form and confirm it was received, and in August asked a question about the listing on the office's official website. The listed lobbyist is Peter Chavkin.
The filing was flagged by the automated pardon-lobbying scan of new lobbying filings; it describes procedural contacts only and does not say whether a pardon was granted or recommended.

sections.headline: Five new House filings, mostly candidate reports; one unreadable trade report
paragraphs: Five House filings are new since the last edition: three candidate financial disclosures, one filing of type D, and one scanned Periodic Transaction Report from Rep. Ro Khanna. Four Senate filings (a periodic transaction report, two candidate reports and an annual-report amendment) and several other House filings in the window were already covered in earlier editions and are not repeated. Two of the five filings (the Thurman Bill Bartie and Rosemary Pino candidate reports) were read; the other three could not be read as text, so nothing is said about their contents. The 30-filing read cap was not reached.

sections.headline: 45 new lobbying registrations, led by defense-tech, health and crypto clients
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying database posted 45 new registrations since October 8, among 649 total filings in the window (mostly third-quarter activity reports). All 45 registrations are listed below; the activity reports were not individually reviewed. BGR Government Affairs signed on the most new clients, mostly defense technology and financial services. Crossroads Strategies, LLC registered for Howard Hughes Management Co., LLC on surface transportation legislation citing H.R.8870, the BUILD America 250 Act.
